newsitem.title: POLAND: PROCHNIK SURGES ON CLEARING OF STAKE SALE.
newsitem.headline: PROCHNIK SURGES ON CLEARING OF STAKE SALE.

text.p: Polish garment maker Prochnik SA surged 9.7 percent to 9.6 zlotys in moderate trade the day after a district court cleared the sale of 10 percent of the firm to National Investment Fund (NFI) No. 12, analysts said.
The shares were among 380,881 held by the Westa insurance firm which went into receivership after bankruptcy.
"Prochnik might now be more rationally managed or will receive an injection of money," one trader said.
Analysts said Prochnik could rise to around 10 zlotys on Wednesday but did not expect the stock to be a long-term gainer. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
